title: Monster Strike Franchise Gets New Mera×Death: Shinigami to Boku no Ijō na Koi TV Anime Starting on January 5
content: MIXI announced on Sunday a new anime in the Monster Strike franchise titled Mera×Death: Shinigami to Boku no Ijō na Koi (Mera×Death: The Unusual Love Between Me and the Grim Reaper), which will debut in Japan on January 5, 2027 on TOKYO MX and 10 other channels, as well as on streaming services.
author: ANN

title: 'Mairimashita! Iruma-kun' Anime Movie Announced
content: The Mairimashita! Iruma-kun ( Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun ) special event "Devils Party 2" announced an anime movie project for the franchise on Sunday. The official website also revealed an announcement image (pictured above) and announcement promo.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun First Theatrical Anime Film Project Announced
content: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun is getting its first theatrical anime film project. The project announcement video was revealed during the DEVIL’S PARTY! 2 event held at Nippon Engineering College Arena in Tokyo on September 27.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Welcome to Demon School, Iruma-kun' Anime Unveils 1st Film Project
content: The "DEVIL'S PARTY! 2" special event for the anime of Osamu Nishi 's Welcome to Demon School, Iruma-kun ( Mairimashita! Iruma-kun ) manga announced in a promotional video on Sunday that the anime's first film project is launching. The video teases that the film will tell a brand-new story.
author: ANN

title: We Are Aliens Film, Eri Short Anime, Candy Caries Win at Ottawa Int'l Animation Festival
content: NOTHING NEW 's We Are Aliens ( Ware Ware wa Uchūjin ) anime film , Honami Yano 's Eri animated short , and Tomoki Misato and Wit Studio 's original television anime Candy Caries were all awarded at the 50th Anniversary Awards Ceremony of the Ottawa International Animation Festival, on Saturday.
author: ANN

title: Millennium Family TV Anime Casts Lynn
content: The staff for the television anime of Sho Kasugai 's Millennium Family ( Odoru Sennen Kazoku ) manga announced on Sunday that Lynn will voice the character Eve, the eldest daughter of the Benfield family. The anime will air on TBS and other stations.
author: ANN

title: Imu Uses Domi Reversi in One Piece Episode 1180 Preview
content: ONE PIECE revealed the preview for Episode 1180, showing Imu using the skill Domi Reversi while facing the giants. This will be the final episode of the year. The anime returned after a 3-month break on April 5, with the crew reaching the giants’ Elbaph Island.
author: Anime Corner

title: Space Battleship Yamato Film Director Toshio Masuda Dies at 98
content: Newspapers Mainichi Shimbun and Yomiuri Shimbun both reported on Thursday that film director and screenwriter Toshio Masuda died of old age on August 26. He was 98. Masuda was born in Kobe in October 1927.
author: ANN

title: 5 Big Moments I Can’t Wait to See in Dragon Ball Super’s New Remake
content: The Fall 2026 anime season is almost here, which means fans will finally get to watch the anticipated Dragon Ball Super: Beerus anime . While fans still have to wait for the main story’s continuation, Toei Animation will first release the remake TV series.
